premise: Bee dances a wiggle to tell where the flowers are; Mouse and Rabbit copy the dance without understanding it and wiggle themselves all the way to the meadow.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So wonder at a real thing (the bee's waggle dance), turned: copying a friend is how you learn where the good things are.
lesson: Join in first; understanding comes on the way.
learning: A bee dances a wiggle to tell the other bees where the flowers are.

en-US.title: Bee's Dance
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} Bee {bee:pulse} came home from the meadow buzzing with news. But she did not say it. She DANCED it. {bee:wobble x3} {sfx:buzz} Wiggle-waggle, wiggle-waggle, round in a circle. [curious] What is she doing? whispered Mouse. {mouse:pulse} I think it is a dance, said Rabbit. {rabbit:pulse} So Mouse wiggled. {mouse:wobble x2} Rabbit waggled. {rabbit:wobble x2} Wiggle-waggle. They had no idea what it meant. But it was fun. Bee turned round. [surprised] You understood! she said. And off she flew. Mouse and Rabbit wiggled after her. Waggle, waggle, hop, hop, through the long grass, over the log, and there — [gasps] a whole meadow of flowers, {flower:glow} yellow and pink and sweet. That is what the dance says, said Bee. Flowers, this way! [giggles] We danced all the way to lunch, giggled Mouse. [happily] And every time Bee came home wiggling after that, two friends wiggled along behind, just to see where it went.

es-ES.title: El baile de Abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} Abeja {bee:pulse} volvió del prado zumbando de noticias. Pero no las dijo. Las BAILÓ. {bee:wobble x3} {sfx:buzz} Meneo-meneo, meneo-meneo, vuelta en círculo. [curious] ¿Qué hace?, susurró Ratón. {mouse:pulse} Creo que es un baile, dijo Conejo. {rabbit:pulse} Y Ratón se meneó. {mouse:wobble x2} Conejo se meneó. {rabbit:wobble x2} Meneo-meneo. No tenían ni idea de lo que significaba. Pero era divertido. Abeja se giró. [surprised] ¡Lo habéis entendido!, dijo. Y salió volando. Ratón y Conejo se fueron meneando detrás. Meneo, meneo, hop, hop, por la hierba alta, por encima del tronco, y allí — [gasps] un prado entero de flores, {flower:glow} amarillas y rosas y dulces. Eso es lo que dice el baile, dijo Abeja. ¡Flores, por aquí! [giggles] Hemos bailado hasta la hora de comer, rio Ratón. [happily] Y desde entonces, cada vez que Abeja volvía meneándose, dos amigos se meneaban detrás de ella, para ver adónde llevaba.
